title: Recurring town
content: For two years, every night, I dream I’m in the same town. The town doesn’t exist in real life. I could describe it and map the place out. It’s mostly a normal town, except in the mall, there is a large room with a row of many doors. Each door leads to a different “video game” (alternate reality), such as being a young boy in a tribal society trying to hunt his first animal. There’s also a forest with an abandoned mansion in it filled with intricate tunnels and hideaways, and a multi-level wooden dock full of restaurants, shops, and seating areas. The content of the dreams is usually very plain or boring, like going to work or planning for a party. Does anyone relate, or does my town sound familiar?
